title: Production AI Readiness, Evaluation & Governance
description: Establish automated quality gates, failure recovery, audit logging, latency/cost budgets, and production readiness documentation.

data.text: The Production Readiness Gate for Enterprise AI

Taking an AI-powered system from prototype to mission-critical production is the culmination of the .NET + React AI Lead journey. An enterprise AI solution cannot go live based merely on a subjective demo. It requires automated quality gates in CI/CD, resilient circuit-breaking fallback strategies, comprehensive audit logs for compliance, strict latency/cost budgets, and documented operational runbooks.

Before any pull request is merged to main or deployed to staging, an automated GitHub Actions workflow executes the evaluation suite against the golden benchmark dataset. The build fails if quality or safety regressions occur.

data.text: Failure Recovery & Graceful Degradation in C#
When downstream AI providers experience 5xx outages, high latency spikes, or 429 quota exhaustion, production systems must degrade gracefully rather than presenting raw stack traces to end users.

data.title: Cascading Fallback and Degradation Pipeline in C#
data.content: Implementing fallback models and graceful degradation when primary AI endpoints fail:

data.title: Essential Audit Trail Requirements
items: Correlation & Trace IDs: Every user message, retrieved chunk ID, tool execution, and model completion shares a single W3C TraceContext traceparent header.
Redacted Prompt Storage: Store full interaction prompts in Azure Cosmos DB or Azure Blob Storage with automatic PII masking applied.
Tool Execution Receipts: Record exact tool names, JSON input arguments, caller principal identity, and human approval signatures.
Token & Cost Ledger: Persist prompt, completion, and cached token counts alongside calculated cost per transaction for accurate financial auditing.

items.hint: Document why specific models, vector stores, and orchestration patterns were chosen.
Complete STRIDE and OWASP Top 10 for LLMs security assessment with legal/security teams.
Define step-by-step procedures for handling hallucinations, model outages, and quota exhaustion.
Set up Grafana / Azure Monitor alerts for 429 spike rates, latency degradation, and token burn rate anomalies.
Establish response time SLAs for human operators reviewing paused agent tool executions.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Production deployment requires objective evaluation quality gates in CI/CD, not subjective demos
Build resilient multi-tier fallback pipelines to handle cloud provider outages gracefully
Maintain immutable audit logs linking correlation IDs, retrieved documents, and tool executions
Track latency and cost budgets continuously against production SLOs
Complete comprehensive production readiness reviews covering threat modeling, ADRs, and operational runbooks
data.takeaway: Achieving production readiness transforms an experimental AI concept into an enterprise-grade platform that is auditable, safe, performant, and resilient under failure.
